notes: These cells are unfilled both in the historical appendix and in Lasry et al. Table 2 / Lasry dissertation Table 6.2, not merely unknown to the 1918 analysts. Baseline fills remain separate hypotheses unless an independent constraint supports them.

An illustrative square in paper Figure 2 / dissertation Figure 6.2 places VF=6 and XA=5, opposite the baseline fill. It also prints N twice (AX and XG), contradicting the final key table. Treat the two digits as unresolved, rather than elevating the inconsistent illustrative figure to an established key.

primary_frame_note: C1 source has 187 slots against 186 advertised. The primary 186-slot model excludes the G at source index 61 from the visibly six-slot group VGVXAA. This one observed-coordinate exclusion is conditional; all six choices within that group remain available with their different fields and word-repair costs.
limits: C1 is a conditional one-exclusion frame; C2 is native. Neither is an asserted solution of the earlier eighth part itself.
The visible noncoordinates H, S and H in C1 are preserved literally and masked in the model. Two masks are filled; the AL?CHIS position remains unresolved.
Deletion alternatives change correlated station/reference labels; those alternatives cannot be freely mixed.
All three digit unknowns in the main date/reference fields are the same XA cell. The two global 5/6 completions are retained without selecting one historically.
